title: OpenNGC
author: Mattia Verga and contributors
changes: Selected objects; normalized identifiers; added Russian names/descriptions. B-band surface brightness preserved as B. Missing values remain null.

title: HYG Database v4.1
author: David Nash / Astronomy Nexus
changes: Sun removed. All entries mag≤7.0 plus entries mag≤9.5 within 2.5° of selected targets; positions rounded to 0.0001°. Columns: ra_deg,dec_deg,Vmag,label,HIP (0 if absent). HYG positions are J2000, fixed-position finder charts; proper motion is not propagated.

title: SIMBAD Astronomical Database
author: CDS, Strasbourg Observatory, France
changes: Positions of HD 226868 and 3C 273; V photometry of HD 226868. Catalogue snapshots, not live measurements.

title: AAVSO VSX / APASS DR9: 3C 273
author: AAVSO
changes: V=12.74 from APASS DR9 and reported V variability range 12.20–13.57. Not a prediction of present brightness.

title: HYG Database 4.1 — planetarium selection
author: David Nash / Astronomy Nexus
changes: Sun removed; HYG entries with magnitude <= 11.5, across the entire sky. Not complete to this magnitude. J2000 positions rounded to 0.00001 degree; proper motion not propagated. Columns: RA degrees, Dec degrees, magnitude, label, HIP, HYG ID.

title: Gaia DR3 — deep target fields
author: ESA / Gaia / DPAC; Gaia@AIP TAP mirror
changes: G=9.5–14 within 0.4 degree of the 306 catalogue targets; Unique source IDs retained. Linear tangent-plane proper-motion propagation from J2016 to J2000; absent proper motions treated as zero. Three-arcsecond crossmatch against HYG removed overlaps. Gaia source IDs retained as strings, row column 7 is G. G is not Johnson V; magnitude limits describe map detail, not visual detectability.
